author: Unbox Therapy
description:
If you've ever thought about building your own product, now’s a great time to take that idea a step further. Alibaba.com’s CoCreate Pitch 2026 is giving entrepreneurs, startups, students, and small businesses the opportunity to compete for a $1M+ prize pool, with every live finalist guaranteed at least $10,000. 

Learn more about the competition and see how Accio Work can help bring your ideas to life.
